title: The History of Shatter Client: My First Great Bodge
desc: I've been wanting to write more about the history of Smash Hit modding for a while, especially the modern "dark age" where the Smash Hit Wiki stopped being updated with new information. I can't think of a better place to start than the Quick Test Client: my first great bodge, and also the start of what I consider the semi-modern era of Smash Hit modding.
